UserDashboard.title: User Dashboard Data
UserDashboard.description: User's study dashboard configuration, tasks, routines, and personalization state

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the dashboard owner

config.description: Dashboard configuration object including widgets, themes, and preferences

dailyRegister.description: Array of daily study register entries

scratchpad.description: User quick notes and scratchpad contents

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp string of when the data was saved

DailyRegistryDay.title: Daily Registry Record
DailyRegistryDay.description: User daily study registry, subject logs, completed tasks, focus duration, and end-of-day summary

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the record owner

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week name (e.g. Monday)

subjectsStudied.description: List of subjects studied on this date

completedTasks.description: List of tasks completed on this date

studySessions.description: Pomodoro and focus study sessions recorded

tuitionRevisionProgress.description: Tuition and revision notes and progress

dailySummaryNotes.description: User reflection and end-of-day study notes

examPrepProgress.description: Board exam and revision preparation progress

entries.description: Map of individual registry activity log items keyed by entryId

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp string of when the registry was saved

/users/{userId}/dashboard/data.description: User-specific persistent study dashboard settings and quick task list

/users/{userId}/dailyRegistry/{date}.description: User daily study registry, activity history, and study summaries
